findings.finding: The imported base accepted six advertised controls without using them, accepted malformed/unknown controls, and its one_object texture failed its own self-check.
findings.root_cause: generate read a raw texture key but otherwise bypassed typed GenCtx draws; the self-check's diagonal test compared against one global cell set and could never identify cross-component corner contact.
findings.repair: Strict validation, exact typed controls, complete constructive placement, observable semantic facts, honest textures, and component-indexed Chebyshev separation checks.

findings.finding: At the two-demo minimum, seeds 27, 34, and 43 let a largest-object-size rotation rival fit every alternate-setting demonstration.
findings.root_cause: Both teaching anchors happened to have the same modulo-object-count offset as the largest object.
findings.repair: Anchor selection now excludes the largest-size modulo offset whenever a legal alternative exists; a 32-seed regression pins border-rank and largest-size refutation.

findings.finding: A rare legal scene could drive the generic backtracking placer into a large search tree.
findings.root_cause: The placer enumerated all legal recursive combinations even though the declared dimensions admit a direct separated-band construction.
findings.repair: Replaced search with bounded constructive row bands; small canvases use separated lines and larger canvases mix compact snakes with lines.

limits: These are observed finite failures and repairs, not a proof against every possible semantic rival.
